lists.addToList.named.doc: Put one or more things on a list the household names ("melk en kaas" are two).
examples: add milk to the shopping list
not: add a comment to the agenda later please

lists.listEntries.named.doc: Read what is on a list the household names (the agenda reads its appointments).
not: what do i still have to do

examples: what do i still have to do
not: what do i do with the milk

assistant.weekOverview.doc: The person's week: their chores, the appointments, what is open.

lists.markListItemDone.stated.doc: Something is done, bought or fixed: tick it off (a chore is completed). Mostly a reply to the bot's own reminder.

assistant.reminders.off.doc: The person switches their own reminders off.

assistant.reminders.on.doc: The person switches their own reminders on again.

lists.addToList.task.doc: A new chore on the chores list, without a who or a day.
not: new task for me: windows, tomorrow

tasks.claimTask.doc: The person takes a chore ("I'll do the windows"). Words that name no chore go to the model.

lists.removeFromList.doc: Take something off a list (a mistake, or no longer needed). Words that name nothing go to the model.
examples: take the milk off the shopping list

lists.shopVisit.doc: At a shop: the general shopping list and that shop's own list(s).
not: i am at the Lidl, been there already

lists.createList.doc: Make a new list (anyone in the household).
examples: create a new list called Holiday

lists.addToList.choreFor.doc: A new chore for a person (me, or a name), optionally with a day after a comma.
examples: new task for me: clean the windows, tomorrow
not: new task for me: windows, end of the month

calendar.addEvent.dayTime.doc: An appointment: a short title, a day and a time ("tandarts morgen om 10 uur"). A sentence about someone, or without a time, is not one.

circle.addItem.typed.doc: In a household circle: put one or more things on a typed list (shopping, chores, repairs, the agenda).
examples: add bananas to the shopping list
not: add a note to the garage

circle.addItem.untyped.doc: In a household circle: add something without naming the list — the app asks which ("voeg toe: X" always; a plain "voeg X toe" only when no conversation is under way, else the model decides).

circle.markComplete.stated.doc: In a household circle: something is bought or done — tick it off by its words.

circle.listOpen.typed.doc: In a household circle: read a typed list (shopping, chores, repairs, the agenda).

circle.listTasks.read.doc: In a household circle: read the tasks.

_trailing.doc: Single words that, AFTER an item, mean it is done ("afwas klaar"). Dutch speakers code-switch, so English ones may be here too.
